identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of ZG006 for Injection Versus Investigator-Selected Chemotherapy in Participants With Advanced Neuroendocrine Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Controlled Study of ZG006 for Injection Versus Investigator-Selected Chemotherapy in Participants With Advanced Neuroendocrine Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This Phase III, multicenter, randomized, open-label, controlled study is designed to assess the efficacy and safety of ZG006 versus investigator-selected chemotherapy in participants with DLL3-positive advanced neuroendocrine carcinoma who have received prior systemic therapy.

interventions.name: ZG006
interventions.description: ZG006 will be administered as an intravenous (IV) infusion.

interventions.name: 5-fluorouracil, Calcium folinate and Irinotecan
interventions.description: Irinotecan 180 mg/m\^2, Calcium folinate 400 mg/m\^2, 5-Fluorouracil: 400 mg/m\^2 by intravenous infusion on Day 1; 5-Fluorouracil: 2400 mg/m\^2 by continuous intravenous infusion over 46 to 48 hours， once two weeks.

primaryOutcomes.description: Duration from the date of initial treatment to the date of death due to any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.description: A duration from the date of initial treatment to disease progression or death of any cause.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has provided written informed consent voluntarily after being fully informed about the study.
* Male or female, aged 18 to 75 years (inclusive) at the time of informed consent signing.
* Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC); small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and combined SCLC are excluded. Additionally, the Participants with DLL3-positive NEC who have received prior systemic therapy (second-line and above)..

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any other condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, makes the participant unsuitable for participation in this study.

locations.facility: The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University
